statement: The performance targets, and what has been measured against them. A target is met only by a measurement on the hardware it names, with the browser, viewport, quality, network and cache recorded. Desktop emulation of a phone or tablet is not a measurement on that device. A cell that the plans leave open reads UNRESOLVED and is not filled with a default.
